hints.title: Binary Search on Penalty
hints.text: The feasibility of achieving maximum bag size m is monotonic: if m is possible, any larger value is also possible.

hints.title: Operations to Split a Bag
hints.text: To ensure a bag of x balls has pieces <= m, you must split it into ceil(x / m) bags using ceil(x / m) - 1 = (x - 1) // m operations.

hints.title: Check Total Operations Bound
hints.text: Sum (x - 1) // m across all bags; if sum <= maxOperations, m is feasible, so try smaller m.

hints.title: Full Implementation

variables: max_val is maximum element in nums (<= 10^9)
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Greedily splitting the largest bag using a priority queue takes O(maxOperations * log n) where maxOperations reaches 10^9.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Binary search on answer evaluates feasibility in 30 iterations of O(n) checks.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate identifies predicate monotonicity and uses integer division (x - 1) // m for split count.
